_meta.note: Purview catalog parsed from Pandora's Box (Revised) Boons chapter (56 rows). boonLadderNames are extracted Boon titles (length 12).

arcaneCalculus.name: Arcane Calculus
arcaneCalculus.description: Purview of Arcane Calculus. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
arcaneCalculus.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
arcaneCalculus.purviewInnateSummary: When performing analysis, research, or surveying investigation actions, you gain +1 Enhancement. You can ignore up to 1 Complication from such actions that would lead you to misinterpret the information you gain on the action. — Masks of the Mythos, Arcane Calculus (Innate Power).
arcaneCalculus.mythosAwarenessInnate: When performing analysis, research, or surveying investigation actions, you gain +1 Enhancement. You can ignore up to 1 Complication from such actions that would lead you to misinterpret the information you gain on the action.

artistry.name: Artistry
artistry.description: Purview of Artistry. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
artistry.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
artistry.purviewInnateSummary: Your performances and crafted works carry clear intent: witnesses experience your chosen emotional or informational message as if you had spoken plainly to them, even across language barriers (you choose who counts as intended audience). You gain Enhancement on appropriate Expression (or related Skill) rolls when creating or performing for others. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
artistry.mythosAwarenessInnate: You draw inspiration and creativity from the people around you. Whenever you are near someone who is performing, creating art, or otherwise doing some type of creative or expressive activity, you gain +3 Enhancement to your own creative endeavors.

asha.name: Asha
asha.description: Purview of Asha. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
asha.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
asha.purviewInnateSummary: You walk the Threefold Path in deed as well as word: when your thoughts, words, and actions align with Asha, gain Enhancement to resist the Druj’s lies and to bolster allies who mirror that harmony. — Mysteries of the World; Pandora’s Box (Revised).

atuaMana.name: Mana
atuaMana.description: Purview of Mana. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
atuaMana.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
atuaMana.purviewInnateSummary: Right relationship shows on your face before your kin: you sense breaches of tapu or improper standing in a community gathering, and you gain Enhancement to call others back into proper roles. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Mana.

beasts.name: Beasts
beasts.description: Purview of Beasts. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
beasts.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
beasts.purviewInnateSummary: You can speak with and understand mundane animals; they are inclined to aid you when you ask, within the limits of their intelligence and nature. You may treat Bonds with animals similarly to Bonds with people for purposes of teamwork the table approves. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
beasts.mythosAwarenessInnate: Animals recognize you as one of their own. Your character can form Bonds with animals in the same way she can people.

beauty.name: Beauty
beauty.description: Purview of Beauty. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
beauty.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
beauty.purviewInnateSummary: Your presence and presentation carry divine weight: when your looks or bearing matter, you gain Enhancement on appropriate social rolls, and attempts to use superficial appeal to manipulate you suffer increased Difficulty or Scale on resistance, as agreed with the Storyguide. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
beauty.mythosAwarenessInnate: You gain a buffer against anyone attempting to use their looks to sway you. Your Scale is considered 1 higher for the purposes of resisting such attempts.

behique.name: Behique
behique.description: Purview of Behique. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
behique.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
behique.purviewInnateSummary: Healing and oath-smoke mark your steps: you sense lingering curses or unfulfilled healing oaths nearby, and you may sanctify small spaces for restful recovery. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Behique.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.description: Purview of Chaos. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
chaos.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
chaos.purviewInnateSummary: Random mishaps and unplanned hazards slide off you: you ignore harm from accidental, unaimed peril (flying debris in a riot, a careless driver’s swerve, being trampled in a panicked crowd) so long as no attacker specifically meant to hurt you. Deliberate attacks and intentional hazards affect you normally. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
chaos.mythosAwarenessInnate: Chaos follows you wherever you go, rippling away from you and upending normally ordered things. Electronics tend to malfunction when you’re near, cars backfire, engines fail, and people trip on sidewalks — all creating a +1 Complication for anyone attempting to act while in close range of you. You are, of course, immune to your own chaos.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.description: Purview of Darkness. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
darkness.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
darkness.purviewInnateSummary: You see clearly in natural darkness and can snuff or dim mundane light sources within Close range as a reflexive trick of shadow; magical darkness may still oppose you per the usual rules. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
darkness.mythosAwarenessInnate: You are always a lucid dreamer, able to control the topic and direction of your own dreams. You can watch another person’s dreams while they sleep and insert yourself into them if you come into physical contact with them (either in the dream or the real world). Doing so puts that person into a lucid dreamer state as well, allowing them control over their own dream. While in the Dreamlands, you are considered to have +1 Leadership Scale.

death.name: Death
death.description: Purview of Death. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
death.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
death.purviewInnateSummary: You sense death’s touch: recent deaths, corpses, and restless dead nearby register clearly; you can read a body’s obvious cause of death. Ghosts and the dead cannot hide their presence from you simply by being unseen (magic that veils them may still apply). — Pandora’s Box (Revised) / Scion: Hero, Death Purview innate.
death.mythosAwarenessInnate: You can sense the presence of death and decay anywhere within medium range. Small things, such as a plant cutting, barely pick up on your radar, while a corpse will resonate and be obvious even if hidden. You can detect ghosts and undead creatures this way as well, even if they are obscured with magic.

deception.name: Deception
deception.description: Purview of Deception. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
deception.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
deception.purviewInnateSummary: Mortal observers cannot reliably catch you in a lie unless they have supernatural aid: mundane Insight or Perception fails automatically to pierce simple falsehoods you speak; supernatural onlookers may invoke a Clash of Wills as usual. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
deception.mythosAwarenessInnate: You can change minor aspects of your appearance at a whim. You cannot change set physical aspects, such as height, weight, or your voice, but all other cosmetic aspects can change. Anyone attempting to recognize you suffers a +3 Complication to pierce your disguise.

denizenEarthFriend.name: Earth Friend
denizenEarthFriend.description: Purview of Earth Friend. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenEarthFriend.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

denizenIllusions.name: Illusions
denizenIllusions.description: Purview of Illusions. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenIllusions.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

denizenLair.name: Lair
denizenLair.description: Purview of Lair. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenLair.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

denizenObdurance.name: Obdurance
denizenObdurance.description: Purview of Obdurance. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenObdurance.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

denizenTransformation.name: Transformation
denizenTransformation.description: Purview of Transformation. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenTransformation.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

denizenWaterFriend.name: Water Friend
denizenWaterFriend.description: Purview of Water Friend. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenWaterFriend.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

denizenWindFriend.name: Wind Friend
denizenWindFriend.description: Purview of Wind Friend. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
denizenWindFriend.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

dodaem.name: Dodaem
dodaem.description: Purview of Dodaem. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
dodaem.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
dodaem.purviewInnateSummary: The Manitou watch through your courtesy: you feel when spirits tied to a place are insulted or pleased, and you gain Enhancement to mediate between humans and local wights. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Dodaem.

dvoeverie.name: Dvoeverie
dvoeverie.description: Purview of Dvoeverie. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
dvoeverie.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
dvoeverie.purviewInnateSummary: Twinned truths tug at you: when someone wears two faces socially, you gain Enhancement to spot the seam, and you may sense hidden worship or dual loyalties in a crowd. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Dvoeverie.

earth.name: Earth
earth.description: Purview of Earth. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
earth.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
earth.purviewInnateSummary: You feel vibrations and shifts through stone and soil touching your feet: you sense movement through connected earth out to a meaningful distance (Storyguide sets exact range), learning approximate mass, direction, and urgency. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
earth.mythosAwarenessInnate: Whenever you are attempting the Knockdown Stunt on an opponent, halve the number of successes needed to perform the stunt (rounded up).

epicCharisma.name: Epic Charisma
epicCharisma.description: Epic Attribute Purview: Epic Charisma. Boons per Pandora's Box (Revised).
epicCharisma.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

epicDexterity.name: Epic Dexterity
epicDexterity.description: Epic Attribute Purview: Epic Dexterity. Boons per Pandora's Box (Revised).
epicDexterity.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
epicDexterity.purviewInnateSummary: You gain +1 Enhancement on rolls using Dexterity where speed, coordination, or precision apply, and once per scene you may waive a single Complication on a Defense roll tied to agility, as the table interprets your tier limits. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
epicDexterity.mythosAwarenessInnate: Your body is extremely flexible, allowing you to perform amazing feats of gymnastics, even going so far as dislocating your joints and bending your bones to slither through improbable spaces or move into irregular shapes.

epicPerception.name: Epic Perception
epicPerception.description: Epic Attribute Purview: Epic Perception. Boons per Pandora's Box (Revised).
epicPerception.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.

epicStamina.name: Epic Stamina
epicStamina.description: Epic Attribute Purview: Epic Stamina. Boons per Pandora's Box (Revised).
epicStamina.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
epicStamina.purviewInnateSummary: You ignore Complications from ordinary hunger, thirst, and fatigue, and you are immune to mundane diseases and environmental illnesses; supernatural ailments still apply. (Epic Stamina also gates many resilience Boons.) — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
epicStamina.mythosAwarenessInnate: Whenever you are suffering Injury Conditions, reduce the Complication imposed by the Condition by 1.

epicStrength.name: Epic Strength
epicStrength.description: Epic Attribute Purview: Epic Strength. Boons per Pandora's Box (Revised).
epicStrength.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
epicStrength.purviewInnateSummary: You gain +1 Enhancement on Might-based rolls where raw power or lifting applies, and you may waive one Complication per scene caused by sheer bulk or weight when carrying or hefting objects, subject to Storyguide limits. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
epicStrength.mythosAwarenessInnate: When you use Might to impress or intimidate others, your allies gain a +1 Enhancement to their next action and enemies suffer a +1 Complication the next time they attempt to act against you or your allies.

fertility.name: Fertility
fertility.description: Purview of Fertility. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
fertility.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
fertility.purviewInnateSummary: Once per scene you can radiate a pulse of vital growth: nearby plants visibly perk or bloom, and allies in line of sight may shed bashing damage as if catching their breath in spring sunlight (resolve specifics at the table). — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
fertility.mythosAwarenessInnate: Once per session you can radiate a wave of sterility, killing plants, stopping growth, and ending the lives of fast-growing organisms. Within your Field, plants die, and anyone there with you is immediately cured of all diseases, and for the rest of the scene they stop suffering Complications from any physical Conditions they suffered. They do not suffer the Conditions, but it does not resolve them.

fire.name: Fire
fire.description: Purview of Fire. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
fire.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
fire.purviewInnateSummary: You cannot take damage or suffer any form of harm from fire, heat, or smoke inhalation. You can walk through wildfires or industrial microwaves unharmed, swim in magma for as long as you can hold your breath, and perform similar feats of fireproof heroism. Extreme cold is likewise harmless to you. Everything you wear is also immune to fire, and you possess the ability to create or douse small flames within Close range at will. You can light or put out a candle or a cigarette with a glance. Finally, you can sense the direction, location, and approximate size of any fire within Extreme Range. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Elemental Manipulation (Fire): Ember Skin.
fire.mythosAwarenessInnate: You can control your anger and fury, keeping it always tamped down. You are immune to Influence that would turn your Attitude to angry and attempts to incite you to action through threats or intimidation incur a +2 Complication.

forge.name: Forge
forge.description: Purview of Forge. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
forge.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
forge.purviewInnateSummary: Tools and machines make sense in your hands: you ignore Complications from unfamiliar controls or improvised use, and you may treat appropriate equipment as one dot better for Enhancement when operating it for its designed task. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
forge.mythosAwarenessInnate: No creation, technology, or artifact is foreign in your hands. When using an unknown item, or something for a purpose not originally intended, you do not suffer any Complication for doing so.

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.description: Purview of Fortune. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
fortune.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
fortune.purviewInnateSummary: You feel when blind chance is being bent: you sense the outcome bias of risky actions around you and notice when another power manipulates fate or prophecy in your presence, even if the effect would normally be hidden. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
fortune.mythosAwarenessInnate: You are the master of your own fate. Attempts to change your luck, fate, or otherwise alter your trajectory suffer a +2 Difficulty. You can, of course, meddle with your own fortune as much as you like.

frost.name: Frost
frost.description: Purview of Frost. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
frost.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
frost.purviewInnateSummary: Cold cannot harm you, nor do ice, snow, or winter terrain impose Complications on your movement; you may briefly freeze a footpath of water or mist solid enough to walk as part of normal movement while the Purview holds. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
frost.mythosAwarenessInnate: You cannot be swayed by emotional appeals or heated seduction. Influence attempts that use Empathy automatically fail, and those using other forms to melt your heart are made at +2 Difficulty.

health.name: Health
health.description: Purview of Health. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
health.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
health.purviewInnateSummary: Your body mends quickly: you heal bashing damage each combat turn, lethal damage on a faster cadence than mortals, and aggravated damage on a daily scale (exact timing per tier in Hero/Pandora’s Box). — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
health.mythosAwarenessInnate: You are always in good health. You are immune to the effects of mundane diseases, though divine or magical diseases affect you normally. If you’ve come into contact with a disease, you can alleviate that disease in others with a touch.

heku.name: Heku
heku.description: Purview of Heku. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
heku.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
heku.purviewInnateSummary: Speaking a true name shapes the soul’s light: you gain Enhancement when acting on ren you know, and you feel when another Netjer scion harvests renown tied to you. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Heku.

journeys.name: Journeys
journeys.description: Purview of Journeys. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
journeys.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
boonLadderNames: Gate at the End of the Year
journeys.purviewInnateSummary: You always know which way to walk to reach a named place in the World unless magic obscures it, and you sense nearby Axis Mundi, gates, or otherworld thresholds within roughly Legend-scaled miles. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
journeys.mythosAwarenessInnate: You always know a back passage, a secret route, or a hidden portal to get where you’re going. If a secret door or hidden passage exists, you find it immediately without having to roll, unless it’s obscured by magic. If you need a secret route through or out of a place, you find one, even if one did not exist before.

marzeh.name: Marzeh
marzeh.description: Purview of Marzeh. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
marzeh.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
marzeh.purviewInnateSummary: Guests and hosts know the law of the table: you sense when hospitality is about to be broken, and you gain Enhancement to enforce oaths sworn over shared bread. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Marzeh.

moon.name: Moon
moon.description: Purview of Moon. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
moon.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
moon.purviewInnateSummary: The moon’s phases answer you: you gain Enhancement when acting under moonlight or while manipulating tides of emotion and transformation tied to lunar cycles; exact bonuses follow the Purview chapter. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
moon.mythosAwarenessInnate: You are mutable and ever-changing. Once per session, you may reshape your body as you see fit. Doing so is a simple action that cannot be combined into a mixed action. You can twist flesh into a new shape, rearrange bones, or even remove parts and save them for later. You may make yourself look completely different, changing your bone structure and physical features, or turn yourself into a nightmare amalgam. You gain a +3 Enhancement to actions that would be enhanced by your changed nature (such as seduction, intimidation, or deception).

nemeton.name: Nemeton
nemeton.description: Purview of Nemeton. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
nemeton.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
nemeton.purviewInnateSummary: Your nemeton is never far: you may sense its condition, and you can open brief passages between its sacred ground and the Field you occupy when the Storyguide agrees the miracle fits (limits on simultaneous nemetons per MotW). — Mysteries of the World; Pandora’s Box (Revised), Nemeton.

order.name: Order
order.description: Purview of Order. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
order.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
order.purviewInnateSummary: When you truthfully explain laws or rightful authority, listeners know you speak correctly for the duration of the scene; you may extend that mantle of legitimacy to innocents you declare free of guilt while using Order marvels or Code of Heaven–compatible effects. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
order.mythosAwarenessInnate: You embody entropy, sapping useful energy from spaces and creating randomness and disorder. You can drain any battery (phone, car, flashlight, etc.) within a short range of its charge, or short out an electrical outlet in the same range without a roll. The lost charge dissipates and becomes useless.

pachakutic.name: Pachakutic
pachakutic.description: Purview of Pachakutic. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
pachakutic.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
pachakutic.purviewInnateSummary: Huaca remember sacrifice: you may bank a point of Legend at a prepared huaca and sense when its stored power is tapped; you gain Enhancement when reading omens in mountains or weather omens tied to world-turning events. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Pachakutic.

paganito.name: Paganito
paganito.description: Purview of Paganito. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
paganito.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
paganito.purviewInnateSummary: Ancestors press close at the threshold: you sense restless dead or broken ancestor bargains within Short range of a home shrine, and you gain Enhancement to negotiate or chastise such spirits. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Paganito.

passion.name: Passion
passion.description: Purview of Passion. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
passion.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
passion.purviewInnateSummary: You read hearts at a glance: you gain Enhancement to uncover or influence strong emotions, and you forge Bonds more readily when you spend a scene reinforcing intimacy or devotion. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
passion.mythosAwarenessInnate: You bond strongly to others. Gain +3 Enhancement whenever you take an action to create or reinforce a Bond.

prosperity.name: Prosperity
prosperity.description: Purview of Prosperity. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
prosperity.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
prosperity.purviewInnateSummary: Fortune’s small kindnesses find you: you always have enough mundane currency for reasonable purchases when it matters to the story, and you can spot lucrative opportunities others overlook. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
prosperity.mythosAwarenessInnate: You always have some currency of the correct kind, even when you reasonably shouldn’t. You don’t have stocks, bonds, or a large bank account, but you always have enough cash to buy someone dinner or grease some palms. Even completely naked in the desert, you’d be able to present cash to your ride for gas.

qut.name: Qut
qut.description: Purview of Qut. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
qut.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
qut.purviewInnateSummary: The eternal blue hears honest wind: you feel when oaths sworn under open sky are tested, and you gain Enhancement to ride or call wind that carries truth-telling voices. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Qut.

shuila.name: Shuilá
shuila.description: Purview of Shuilá. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
shuila.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
shuila.purviewInnateSummary: The tablets remember deeds before speech: when you gather clues toward a declared Deed, later rolls using the same Skill + Attribute toward that Deed may buy Enhancements from those threshold successes, and catastrophic failure may be bought as future complications instead (see Me of the Deed). — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Shuilá.

sky.name: Sky
sky.description: Purview of Sky. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
sky.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
sky.purviewInnateSummary: Weather in your vicinity responds to your mood in small ways, and you may nudge clouds, wind, or temperature within reason without spending Legend for minor atmospheric shifts. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
sky.mythosAwarenessInnate: You can control the natural weather patterns in your area. You can lessen or heighten a storm, push a cold front far north to miss the city you’re in, or drag a nearby storm into the area, rapidly turning blue skies stormy gray.

stars.name: Stars
stars.description: Purview of Stars. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
stars.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
stars.purviewInnateSummary: Once per scene you may read a thread of destiny written in the stars, asking the Storyguide one concrete yes/no about an action you or a Bandmate is about to take; they answer truthfully to the best of their knowledge. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
stars.mythosAwarenessInnate: Once per scene, you can divine the unknowable from the stars. You can ask your Storyguide a single question about the possible outcomes of an action you or one of your Bandmates is about to take, and the Storyguide must answer you truthfully.

sun.name: Sun
sun.description: Purview of Sun. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
sun.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
boonLadderNames: Falling Through the Edge of Time
sun.purviewInnateSummary: You are a walking atmosphere: you may raise or lower hope within a Field as if you were a minor environmental effect, with rating tied to half your Legend (see Sun Purview chapter). — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
sun.mythosAwarenessInnate: Your presence is polarizing, causing people gain or lose hope at your whim. You are a walking atmosphere (Scion: Origin p. 78), which you can make either positive or negative as you like, with a rating equal to half your Legend that affects anyone in the same Field as you.

tianming.name: Tianming
tianming.description: Purview of Tianming. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
tianming.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
tianming.purviewInnateSummary: Mandate flickers when rulers fail Heaven’s measure: you sense unjust edicts or corrupt magistrates within a civil scene, and you gain Enhancement to call out Heaven’s displeasure with evidence. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Tianming.

tzolkin.name: Tzolk'in
tzolkin.description: Purview of Tzolk'in. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
tzolkin.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
tzolkin.purviewInnateSummary: Named days arrive carrying weight: once per session you may declare a day’s omen and gain Enhancement on actions that lean into or avert that omen, as the calendar permits. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Tzolk’in.

war.name: War
war.description: Purview of War. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
war.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
war.purviewInnateSummary: Whenever you are embroiled in conflict—social, mental, or physical—you gain Enhancement on actions that escalate or press the fight rather than defuse it. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
war.mythosAwarenessInnate: Whenever you are involved in a conflict (not just physical, any conflict will do) you gain +2 Enhancement to actions that further the conflict rather than working to resolve it.

water.name: Water
water.description: Purview of Water. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
water.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
water.purviewInnateSummary: Water welcomes you: you breathe and move through water as easily as air for mundane environments, and liquid currents subtly assist you, granting Enhancement when swimming or manipulating flowing water. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
water.mythosAwarenessInnate: You have the grace and implacable movement of water. When you set yourself on a path, nothing can prevent you from moving forward. Actions that would stop you, slow you down, or change your course are made at +2 Difficulty. You can ignore Complications that would slow your movement and make a Clash of Wills if the Complication comes from a magical source. This isn’t just walking, it’s any kind of forward movement, including flying, biking, driving a car, etc.

wild.name: Wild
wild.description: Purview of Wild. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
wild.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
wild.purviewInnateSummary: The wild recognizes its kin: animals native to untamed places treat you with favorable Attitude unless you provoke them, and you gain Enhancement when surviving or navigating hostile wilderness. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).
wild.mythosAwarenessInnate: You are a child of wilderness and wild things recognize you as such. Gain +2 Enhancement when dealing with wild animals or hostile environments. Wild animals always have a positive initial Attitude towards your character unless she does something to frighten or anger them.

wyrd.name: Wyrd
wyrd.description: Purview of Wyrd. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
wyrd.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
wyrd.purviewInnateSummary: You perceive bindings of orlæg and oaths that touch you: when a Fatebinding relevant to you is created or tugged, the Storyguide should give you a sensory cue, and you gain Enhancement to uncover or contest hidden wyrd laid on people or places you study. Æsir also work marvels of binding and foretold consequence per the Wyrd chapter. — Scion: Hero; Pandora’s Box (Revised).

yaoyorozuNoKamigami.name: Yaoyorozu-no-Kamigami
yaoyorozuNoKamigami.description: Purview of Yaoyorozu-no-Kamigami. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
yaoyorozuNoKamigami.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
yaoyorozuNoKamigami.purviewInnateSummary: Myriad kami murmur in busy places: you sense shrines, pollution, or offended spirits in urban crowds, and you gain Enhancement to appease or command minor kami tied to a location. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Yaoyorozu no Kamigami.

yidam.name: Yidam
yidam.description: Purview of Yidam. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
yidam.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
yidam.purviewInnateSummary: Your meditation opens vistas beyond the self: you gain Enhancement when discerning illusions or soul-tests tied to practiced devotion, and you may briefly manifest an advisor-aspect of your yidam for counsel. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Yidam.

yoga.name: Yógá
yoga.description: Purview of Yógá. Boons and Marvels per Pandora's Box (Revised).
yoga.mechanicalEffects: Standard Purview ladder (up to 12 Boons) per tier and Legend.
yoga.purviewInnateSummary: Disciplined breath aligns body and truth: you ignore Complications from ordinary fatigue during yoga-like centering, and you gain Enhancement on Academics or Occult rolls to recall sacred practice. — Pandora’s Box (Revised), Yógá.

magic.name: Magic
magic.description: Occult mastery that taps power external to a wielder’s nature—how Sorcerers and some Gods work miracles (not the same as “all divine miracles are magical”).
magic.mechanicalEffects: Innate: sense Sorcerers; after witnessing another’s Marvel/Boon in scene, reduce your Legend cost to emulate that effect with Magic by 1 (min 1). Heroes with Magic access one Working; Demigods two; Gods three; Techniques as Heroic Knacks. Scions/Gods gain Magic only via Relics/Guides (PDF).
